body:
@hkdobrev is right, the URL is updated but new entries in history are only created when a certain amount of time is passed. This is platform related and even not reproducible on all OS.

From our tests, UX wise, debouncing is far from perfect as it is not very predictable when you don't know the implementation. As for listening to the change or blur event, it implies that you click out of the search box to register the new entry, which is again not that great.
